prompt.system: You are an offline, non-authoritative open-world semantic proposer. Never call a tool, choose an action, alter the capability catalog, or remove a hypothesis. Follow the supplied JSON contract exactly.
prompt.userPayload: exact V105 render_prompt JSON with the frozen visible catalog, V105 instruction, response contract, observation flag, and either the selected utterance or frozen missing-observation sentinel

metricDefinitions.structuredResponseValidity: valid V105 response count divided by all 192 generations
metricDefinitions.observedMetrics: V106 metrics computed only on 128 development-evaluation observations after invalid-output fallback
metricDefinitions.controlledMissingObservationAbstentionAc: parsed ABSTAIN count divided by 64 missing-observation controls after invalid-output fallback
metricDefinitions.confidenceCalibration: raw model confidence on observed predictions only; no post-hoc calibration
metricDefinitions.meanDecisionRegret: V106 frozen shadow cost over 128 observed evaluation records
metricDefinitions.regretAboveBestNonOracleDeterministicBas: model observed mean regret minus frozen ask-always mean regret 1.125
metricDefinitions.trueHypothesisRetention: 1.0 by architecture because the permanent 17-hypothesis universe is never pruned

decisionRule.completedCondition: all 192 independent no-retry generations and access gates complete regardless of quality
decisionRule.qualifyingCondition: every development and access gate passes noncompensatorily
decisionRule.ifQualifying: freeze outcome and separately preregister one protected-test run with the identical prompt model decoding and gates
decisionRule.ifNonqualifying: freeze negative development outcome and close the model branch without protected-test access
